# Sotheby's

> > Sotheby's is a premier international auction house specializing in fine art, contemporary art, and collectibles with locations in New York, London, Paris, Hong Kong, and worldwide.

The site provides artist biographies, auction results, past lot information, and artwork sales across categories including contemporary art, impressionist and modern art, European art, Chinese art, and sculpture. Sotheby's operates globally with auction houses and representatives in major art market centers.

## Key Topics

- Artist biographies and auction results
- Contemporary art sales
- Impressionist and modern art
- Chinese art and Hong Kong auctions
- European art market
- Artwork listings and past lots
- International auction locations
- Private sales and consignment
- Art valuations and appraisals
- Sculpture and kinetic art
- Surrealist art
- Post-war and contemporary artists
- Art market trends and analysis

## Major Auction Locations

- [Sotheby's Paris | Art Auction & Sales](https://www.sothebys.com/en/about/locations/paris): Sotheby's Paris auction house with exhibitions, gallery & private sales
- [Madrid | Auction, Department and Representatives Locations](https://www.sothebys.com/en/about/locations/madrid): Sotheby's Madrid office location, services & international art experts
- [Lisbon | Auction, Department and Representatives Locations](https://www.sothebys.com/en/about/locations/lisbon): Sotheby's Portugal office in Lisbon with consignment & valuation services

- [Peter Dreher | Art for Sale, Results & Biography](https://www.sothebys.com/en/artists/peter-dreher): Peter Dreher contemporary artist known for Day by Day Good Day series
- [George Rickey | Art for Sale, Results & Biography](https://www.sothebys.com/en/artists/george-rickey): George Rickey kinetic sculpture artist page with auction results
